Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::genereateApprovalLetter(id:Integer): Boolean {
          definition:
          loanRequest:LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstance()->any(o | o.RequestID = id)
            
            precondition:
          LoanRequest.allInstance()->includes(loanRequest)
            
            postcondition:
          let letter:ApprovalLetter in letter.oclIsNew() and letter.Content = 'ApprovalLetterContent' and ThirdPartyServices.save(letter) and loanRequest.AttachedApprovalLetter = letter and CurrentLoanRequest = loanRequest and result = true
